tasks.label: git-log-check
tasks.command:
cd /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I && git add boot/initramfs/init build/build.sh && git commit -m 'fix: write dmesg.txt from initramfs before switch_root' -m 'S03boot-import approach depended on too many userspace steps. Writing
dmesg in the initramfs init script is simpler: the MMC device is already
confirmed present, we are in a writable ramfs, and nothing can fail before us.

Mount p1 (FAT, ONIKIRI) rw, write dmesg.txt, unmount — before switch_root.
Also pre-create /mnt in the initramfs cpio stage.' && git push origin HEAD:Default 2>&1 | tee /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I/.vscode/new_job.txt

tasks.label: git-commit-drm-diagnostics
tasks.command:
cd /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I && git add kernel/dts/sun50i-h616-hdmi.dtsi config/uboot/boot.cmd rootfs/etc/init.d/rcS rootfs/etc/init.d/S03boot-import .github/workflows/build-image.yml && git diff --cached --stat && git commit -m 'fix: DRM diagnostics — fallback compatibles, drm.debug=0x3f, dmesg to FAT' -m 'Add H6 fallback compatibles to de_clk and hdmi_phy so the DRM pipeline probes even if patches 001/002 had hunk-offset mismatches against 6.6.30.

Write dmesg.txt to the ONIKIRI FAT partition on every boot via S03boot-import (which already mounts p1), so the kernel log can be read on any PC.

Increase drm.debug from 0 to 0x3f for full DRM trace in dmesg output.

Bump rootfs cache key to v3 to force rebuild with updated init scripts.' && git push origin HEAD:Default 2>&1 | tee /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I/.vscode/new_job.txt

tasks.label: git-push-ci-fixes
tasks.command: ( cd /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I && git add onikiri/modules/hid_gadget.py onikiri/ui/bridge.py onikiri/ui/assets/index.html onikiri/ui/assets/app.js && git commit -m 'feat: HID device ID dropdown with add/remove custom profiles' && git push origin HEAD:Default ) 2>&1 | tee /workspaces/Onikiri-Mk.I/.vscode/new_job.txt
